*lig70N PCR*

40X reactions for the lig70N were performed with 1 uL of 10-fold diluted original DNA per tube.

Gel was run and concentration of the pooled PCR1 product was estimated.

Conc \= 17 ng/uL

Trial for PCR2 with SELEX PCR master-mix:

22.5 uL Mix \+ 1 uL PCR1 \+ 1.5 uL H2O
